account_id.description: UUID of the Account that the Conversion belongs to.

creator_contact_id.description: UUID of the Contact that requested the conversion.

short_reference.description: A human readable unique trade indentifier, in the format YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX.

settlement_date.description: The date and time by which funds need to be available to settle the trade.

conversion_date.description: The date the conversion will be made.

currency_pair.description: Concatenated string of the two currencies traded, eg. "USDEUR".

buy_currency.description: The three-character ISO code of the currency being purchased.

sell_currency.description: Three character ISO code for the currency being sold.

fixed_side.description: Which currency side is fixed -  the buy or sell one.

partner_buy_amount.description: The amount of buy currency for a partner.

partner_sell_amount.description: The amount of sell currency for a partner.

client_buy_amount.description: The amount of buy currency for a client.

client_sell_amount.description: The amount of sell currency for a client.

mid_market_rate.description: The midpoint between the buy and sell rates.

partner_rate.description: The market rate + Currencycloud commission (if applicable).

client_rate.description: The rate that will be returned to your customer after all spread has been applied.

deposit_required.description: Is a deposit required for the conversion?

deposit_amount.description: The amount of a deposit required.

deposit_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the currency the deposit is shown in.

deposit_required_at.description: Date by which deposit is required, format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.

unallocated_funds.description: The buy amount from the trade, that has not been allocated towards funding a payment.

payment_ids.description: The id of payments linked with this conversion - these payments won’t be processed until the conversion settles.

unique_request_id.description: User-generated idempotency key. Beneficial for request tracking / management.

updated_at.description: Date the conversion was last updated.
